WALL BUILD-UPS (mm) - boards are 2 x 13 Soundchek + damping
Dividing wall 282: 26 board | 90 stud + Rockwool | 50 air gap | 90 stud + Rockwool | 26 board. Studio
frame is freestanding and carries the ceiling; bedroom frame is fixed to trusses and slab. Bedroom face
Window-wall and back-wall leaves 166: 50 air gap | 90 stud + Rockwool | 26 board. Existing walls and
plaster left on and untouched. Window architraves sit inside the gap. Frames stand on the slab on a
Hallway wall (existing, kept): studio-side plaster stripped, cavity filled with Rockwool, re-lined 26.
Studio face moves in 16. Coupled to the house, so it is the inner leaf of the double wall on this side.
Recess wall 187 in the 205 living-room recess: 50 air gap | 90 stud + Rockwool | 26 board | 21 slat
panelling. Face 18 behind the wardrobe wall plane. Freestanding, flexible sealed joint under the fascia.
Recess length assumed to run the full studio wall (TBC).
Window 1 plug (removable): board / Rockwool / board in the reveal, about 40 deep, compression
seals, 10 to 20 off the glass. Sliders locked and sealed. Check reveal depth on site; it can stand
Double door, leaf 820 assumed (700 drawn earlier): inner solid-core leaf swings in, outer hidden
slat-clad leaf (2260 high, up to the fascia) swings out. Hinges on the ensuite side, hinge jamb
100 off the back wall. About 220 dead air between leaves; perimeter seals and drop seal on both.
Open outer leaf covers the WIR switch.
112 The Gateway, Lilydale - Studio Build - studio (back) + bedroom (door end)
Scale 1:25 at A3. Dimensions in mm. Drawn over the frozen BASE PLAN geometry (unchanged).
Concept only: thicknesses assumed, to be verified on site and with the builder. Not for construction.
Ceiling: plaster stripped, blown-in insulation replaced with Rockwool. New independent joists
(about 140 x 45, size by builder) at 450, run back wall to dividing wall and bear on the
freestanding studio frames only. 25 clear of the truss chords. Two layers Soundchek with damping
compound, edges sealed, Rockwool over. Finished ceiling about 2230 to 2250.
Fan well: 340 square lined box between two joists and two trusses (bay TBC in roof space), canopy
at 2420 so blades sit at 2100 (fan drop 320). Two layers of board, own brace on the new joists,
Services: P3 moved onto the new back wall; P2 sits in the dividing-wall zone and is relocated; H2
blocked off and sealed above the new ceiling; DL2 removed; new studio switch. Fire-rated acoustic
putty pads on all boxes. Electrician does all fixed wiring.
Kit on a decoupled riser on the slab. Kit footprint is indicative only.
Recess length and pillar; truss spacing and chord underside (assumed 2410); window 1 reveal depth;
fan model drop; door width 700 or 820; who supplies Rockwool.
